children: AES received Public Utilities Commission of Ohio approval for its March 2026 merger agreement with Horizon Parent.
PUCO issued approval on Sept. 17, 2026, satisfying a merger closing condition under the March 1, 2026 Merger Agreement.
Merger remains subject to additional regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions before completion.
Upon closing, AES will be jointly owned by vehicles affiliated with Global Infrastructure Management and EQT Infrastructure VI and other investors.
Company reiterates forward‑looking risks including regulatory, litigation, financing, operational disruption and timing uncertainties.
